item.title: Rising summer electricity bills trigger protests and service cutoffs
item.description: Electricity costs are climbing during summer heat as fans and air conditioners run constantly. In Tulsa, Oklahoma, some residents face disconnections.

item.title: Comic: Seven lifestyle habits that may improve fertility odds
item.description: This illustrated guide offers evidence-based tips for supporting fertility in men and women, covering diet, activities, and other lifestyle factors.

item.title: Fire in Pakistan hospital nursery kills 14 newborns; inquiry ordered
item.description: A fire broke out early Wednesday in a newborn nursery at a major government hospital in Pakistan's capital, killing 14 infants, hospital officials said.

item.title: Summer box office shines, but numbers hide troubling trends
item.description: Theaters offered diverse films, and audiences paid more for premium formats like IMAX. Yet attendance is down, suggesting a complex picture.
